name: Noel Marres Ascot
original_name: ノエル・マーレス・アスコット
source:
Daughter of a marquess family, her jousting skills are top-class. Noel puts in all she has got into the competitions because she promised her younger sister that she would never lose when she is competing in front of her.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Walkure_Romanze]Wikipedia[/url]]
